ezekiel.8.p1.b1.text: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.

ezekiel.8.p1.b2.text: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.

ezekiel.8.p1.b3.text: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem …

ezekiel.8.p1.b4.text: And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.

ezekiel.8.p1.b5.text: Son of man … now lift up your eyes to the north.

ezekiel.8.p1.b6.text: Son of man … do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing—to drive Me far from My sanctuary? Yet you will see even greater abominations.

ezekiel.8.p2.b1.text: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.

ezekiel.8.p2.b2.text: Son of man … dig through the wall.

ezekiel.8.p2.b3.text: So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.

ezekiel.8.p2.b4.text: Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here.

ezekiel.8.p2.b5.text: So I went in and looked, and engraved all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast, along with all the idols of the house of Israel.

ezekiel.8.p2.b6.text: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel … Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

ezekiel.8.p2.b7.text: The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.

ezekiel.8.p2.b8.text: Son of man … do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol?

ezekiel.8.p2.b9.text: You will see them committing even greater abominations.

ezekiel.8.p3.b1.text: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.

ezekiel.8.p3.b2.text: Son of man … do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.

ezekiel.8.p3.b3.text: … there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun.

ezekiel.8.p3.b4.text: Son of man … do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here … Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!

ezekiel.8.p3.b5.text: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
